items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And, Buddy, come up here, man, and no trouble.

ctx.x: Milt went all over the theater saying, "Do you know one thing?" He said, "John and all them bass players, come up here, man, and try to play this thing. And, Buddy, come up here, man, and no trouble."
We played it right away. We played it, too.
